testSmells.title: Improper Organization
testSmells.message:
It does not have a Proper Organization.

Tests should have the following structure:

- Arrange: This is where you initialize objects and set the value of the data to be passed to the function under test.

- Act: The act section invokes the function under test.

- Assert: This is where you verify that the action of the function under test behaves as expected.

So asserts should be together at the end of the test.

		inject: CrawlerNoCommand new

displaceBy: aDisplacement

advance

	(sonar groundAt: position) turnClockwise: self

test08aWhenFacingRightIncrementsX

	| crawler |
	
	crawler := SurveyCrawler at: 1@2 facing: #Right.
	
	crawler process: 'a'.
	
	self assert: (crawler isAt: 2@2 facing: #Right)

test04hWhenFacingUpMakesCrawlerFaceRight

	| crawler |
	
	crawler := SurveyCrawler at: 1@2 facing: #Up.
	
	crawler process: 'h'.
	
	self assert: (crawler isAt: 1@2 facing: #Right)

test36BoulderInGuardedRunUndoesItsAdvances

	self
		assert: (self crawlerAt12FacingUpOver: SeabedBoulder new at: 1@4)
		failsProcessing: '(aa)'
		with: SurveyCrawler boulderFoundErrorDescription
		leavingItAt: 1@2
		facing: #Up
